sharedPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial blog cover and thumbnail for Talko AI, a customer engagement platform. Create a premium realistic photograph with tasteful integrated interface elements, not a cartoon, icon collage or abstract 3D render. Landscape composition approximately 1.91:1. Clean bright modern small-business workspace, natural window light, authentic materials and believable devices. Talko palette expressed subtly through electric-blue and cyan accents against off-white and navy. One instantly understandable focal story that remains clear at 360px width. Keep important subjects inside the central 80% for thumbnail crops. No headlines, no long text, no numbers, no fabricated statistics, no watermarks, no brand logos. Any interface is generic illustrative UI with simple large symbols and unobtrusive lines, never a fabricated screenshot of a real platform. Commercial editorial photography, crisp natural detail, soft depth of field.

images.subject: A close-up realistic smartphone standing on a desk in front of a softly blurred business owner and laptop. On its generic customer-messaging dashboard, three large distinct status tiles: a green check circle, an amber warning triangle, and a red restricted padlock. The amber warning tile is the main focus. The visual should instantly communicate understanding messaging account warnings and limits, not a hacked device. No letters, no words, no fake data.

Realistic close-up of a person's hand editing a customer-message draft on a laptop at a tidy desk. Two large simple translucent message-preview cards in the foreground: one with a clear red X, the other with a green approval check, connected by a subtle blue correction arrow. A smartphone sits beside the laptop. Instantly communicates fixing a rejected message template. No readable words, no fake official interface.

Realistic tidy business desk: a smartphone displaying large generic chat bubbles beside a compact calculator, a paper invoice with softly blurred lines and a few Indian rupee coins, with a business owner's hands calmly reviewing them. Phone and calculator dominate the frame. Communicate the cost of business messaging, without any specific price, amount, date, chart or rate.

Realistic smartphone held over a bright office desk. A generic social-media post on screen has a prominent public comment bubble with three small avatar circles; beside the phone a single elegant translucent private-message card with an envelope and small padlock. A clean blue curved arrow connects public comment to private message. Large simple visual elements, instantly understandable comment-to-DM journey. No words, no platform logos.

A realistic business owner at a laptop in a bright welcoming service-business workspace, with a smartphone in the near foreground showing a generic customer review card: five large warm gold stars above unobtrusive review lines, and a blue reply bubble with a small check below. The review-and-reply card is the sharp focal point, the owner softly blurred. Communicate personal, thoughtful review replies. No readable review text, no company logos.

Realistic over-the-shoulder view of a small-business owner working at a laptop with a smartphone alongside. Across the laptop's generic interface, three large clean connected visual steps: incoming customer chat, a blue AI sparkle, and a completed reply check. A few subtle message notifications connect the phone and laptop. Show an organised, helpful automated messaging workflow rather than a robot character. Bright daylight, warm human context, no words or numbers.

Realistic macro editorial still life: an elegant metallic physical key with a blue translucent key head resting beside a laptop trackpad and smartphone on a clean off-white desk. On the softly visible laptop display are three simple generic AI connection nodes linked to one central key symbol, without logos. The physical key is the main sharp subject and a subtle cyan light reflects on its metal. Communicate owning and controlling your AI access, not cryptocurrency or password theft. No words or numbers.

Realistic close-up of a creator's hands holding a smartphone in a bright creative studio, with a generic private-message conversation on screen and a prominent blue safety shield containing a white check next to the chat. Background laptop and small content-creation equipment softly blurred. Friendly, confident, responsible private messaging, not cybersecurity alarm imagery. One strong focal phone and readable large symbols, no words, no fake official platform screens or logos.
